info.name: BlackTrader Terminal — Full API Collection (Current MAM + OMS)
info.description:
Updated for https://terminal.blacktrader.com/test on 2026-11-21.

The collection uses direct OMS login at /v1/oms/_auth/login, Real Hedging OMS routes, current MAM allocation fields, qty-based orders, /reduce partial closes, and sl/tp/trailing protection. The existing snake_case environment variable names are preserved. Run Auth Setup first. Trading requests create real-engine test exposure and may copy to active MAM followers; use dedicated test accounts and always run Teardown. Admin requests are optional and require separate admin credentials.
